title: FLIR1 video leaked on a German server before 2017

tellings.quote: Reddit and it was even on a German server.

plain: The FLIR1 video, Navy infrared footage from 2004 of the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint, was online long before 2017, on Reddit and "even on a German server". Michels says this himself in a debate with the UFO skeptic Mick West. His point is that the footage was out in the world before it made official news.
